name: Grim
source:
Nikita is no longer a student, but he still hasn’t found his place in life.
He’s sliding deeper into the abyss - using illegal substances, working a job he hates, slowly fading away.
A ghostly girl begins to haunt him - someone who once loved him. He sees her in dreams, in passing strangers.
Each encounter reminds him of his vices, the mistakes he’s made.
Will he be able to learn from these dances of ghosts born of a troubled mind - lessons that could change his life for the better - or will he become forever lost in the world he’s created himself…?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
尼基塔不再是学生了，但他仍然没有找到自己的人生定位。
他正在滑向更深的深渊——使用非法药物，做着他讨厌的工作，慢慢地消失。
一个幽灵般的女孩开始困扰他——一个曾经爱过他的人。他在梦中、在路过的陌生人身上看到了她。
每次遭遇都会让他想起自己的恶习和所犯的错误。
他能否从这些因烦恼而诞生的鬼魂的舞蹈中学到一些可以让他的生活变得更好的教训，或者他会永远迷失在他自己创造的世界中……？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606000/]Steam[/url]]
